notes.title: Miniatures: Achievements Unlocked ✨
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616006/826d72e4b48c6cfe828dbbb9fb7032f96fcc1885.png[/img]

Whether you're someone who loves collecting them or enjoys the little “ping”, we’ve added four easy achievements to celebrate the anthology format of Miniatures 🦎🐚🪛🦋

[b]What to Expect: [/b]

- 4 achievements in total
- Simple and easy to find

The achievements were designed to be light — they’ll satisfy the collector’s heart, but will also keep the stories uninterrupted. 

If you’ve already visited these worlds, this might be a nice reason to return. And if you’re just arriving — happy exploring 💛

notes.title: 💛 Miniatures Honorable Mentions at IGF 💛
notes.content:
We're so excited to share the news that Miniatures has received two honorable mentions at IGF 2025 💛
[list]
[*] Excellence in Narrative
[*] Excellence in Visual Art
[/list]
Check out the full list [url=https://igf.com/article/consume-me-leads-5-nominations-2025-igf-awards?_mc=edit_gdcsf_gdcsf_le_x_9_x_2025]here[/url] and congrats to all nominees and honorable mentions! Can't wait to play them all!

~ The Others

notes.title: Miniatures is in Next Fest
notes.content:
February has crept up on us! After a busy start to 2024 traveling around Europe and spending time with family and friends, we're back and thrilled to join Next Fest on Steam from today. It's a wonderful opportunity to see what other incredible studios are up to, play some games, and share our own work.

Haven't seen our Miniatures demo yet? Give it a try and tell us your thoughts.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2428840/Miniatures/

[h2]Q&A[/h2]

Join us for our Miniatures Q&A sessions on our Steam page during Next Fest. We've gathered your questions and will be answering them, all while showing you around one of the stories from Miniatures, Familiar.

For more details, check out our events on Steam.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616006/f07b4571fbfe61c885d4c1adbb1a1b839ef80aec.png[/img]

[h2]Join the Others on Discord[/h2]

We have a lovely community on Discord. If you love talking about the weird and wonderful games you play or getting news from the team at Other Tales.

🤖 [url=https://discord.com/invite/othertales]https://discord.com/invite/othertales[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44616006/9bd4ef70aa0ef14ba0a85d61ec088f85d63c9991.png[/img]

[h2]Other Games from Other Tales[/h2]

Interested in our first game? Check out Tick Tock: A Tale for Two. It's a cooperative puzzle game for two players and a great example of what we love to make: engaging games with intriguing stories.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/790740/Tick_Tock_A_Tale_for_Two

Let's make this Next Fest a memorable one!

~ The Others 💛
